Title: TC 83849.2: Topology - Asset Configuration and Initial Schedules

Step Action: Prerequisite: TC 83849.1 has been completed successfully
In Admin Utility > Asset Configuration, add an asset for Recon. Click browse to location of local Recon dataset and save
Step Expected: Recon asset is configured with dataset path saved

Step Action: In Admin Utility > Asset Configuration, add an asset for Network Devices. Click browse to location of local Network Devices dataset and save
Step Expected: Network Devices asset is configured with dataset path saved

Step Action: In Admin Utility > Asset Configuration, add an asset for Cyber (no dataset path needed)
Step Expected: Cyber asset is created

Step Action: In Admin Utility > Asset Configuration, add an asset for Inventory (no dataset path needed)
Step Expected: Inventory asset is created

Step Action: In Admin Utility > Schedules, create a schedule for Recon. In Sequences Tab, select the Recon Asset from dropdown, scroll down the Definitions list and select 'All XML', click '>' to move it to sequences panel. Click OK
Step Expected: Recon schedule is created successfully

Step Action: Right click on the Recon schedule row and select Run Now. Monitor for completion
Step Expected: Recon schedule completes. Expected 'errors' may appear - refer to qastore data folder readme.txt for documentation of expected errors

Step Action: In Admin Utility > Schedules, create a schedule for Network Devices. In Sequences Tab, select the Network Devices Asset from dropdown, select 'All' or 'All Sequences' from Definitions and click '>' to move it to sequences panel. Click OK
Step Expected: Network Devices schedule is created successfully

Step Action: Right click on the Network Devices schedule row and select Run Now. Monitor for completion
Step Expected: Network Devices schedule completes with no unexpected errors

Step Action: Go to Admin Utility > Asset Explorer Configuration and expand the subfolders for both Recon and Network Devices assets to verify data objects are visible
Step Expected: Asset Explorer Configuration shows both assets with expandable data objects

Step Action: Test Completed: Asset configurations are created and initial schedules have been run successfully for Recon and Network Devices
